findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.middle.network" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dns_propagation, dns_health, subdomains, bimi, mta_sts, email_score, ct_logs, domain_age, domain_available · Private data: dns_lookup, dns_record, dns_propagation, dnssec, dns_health, dns_speed, subdomains, zone_precheck, mx, spf, dkim, dmarc, bimi, tls_rpt, bulk_sender, email_generators, dmarc_reports, cert_decoder, asn, whois, whois_ip, domain_age, domain_available, geoip, bulk_ip, zone_format, list_probes, verify_api_key · Public sink: reverse_dns, email_headers, email_score, email_generators, cert_decoder, subnet, punycode · Destructive: subnet, ip_convert, zone_format.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dns_propagation, dns_health, subdomains, bimi, mta_sts, email_score, ct_logs, domain_age, domain_available · Private data: dns_lookup, dns_record, dns_propagation, dnssec, dns_health, dns_speed, subdomains, zone_precheck, mx, spf, dkim, dmarc, bimi, tls_rpt, bulk_sender, email_generators, dmarc_reports, cert_decoder, asn, whois, whois_ip, domain_age, domain_available, geoip, bulk_ip, zone_format, list_probes, verify_api_key · Public sink: reverse_dns, email_headers, email_score, email_generators, cert_decoder, subnet, punycode · Destructive: subnet, ip_convert, zone_format

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
